answer: Because the gale audit records the origin of every admitted key, a cluster arriving through one uplink is visible after the fact. A farm as a result spreads across origins and forfeits for the distribution, while each origin still has to clear the sable quota and the nebula admission check. Admission is capped at 3 new identities per origin per day, which is the limit that makes bulk registration expensive rather than impossible. That is 39 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
